A run of the rule that is itself inconclusive takes the retry as its own
rulings.precedence: FR-25's (D278, D282; Q6): within a run, an out-of-window order makes it inconclusive (its estimate is not trusted), and it takes the retry; per world and overall, any failed run makes the verdict failed, else any inconclusive run makes it inconclusive, else it is passed
rulings.order: no judged run before this erratum's tag: the registered order holds (Q2)
rulings.zero_rate_fate_survivors: the four survivors at a zero-rate fate, survivors_R at p = 0 and survivors_R_s at p = 1, each with both machine options, are judged as zero, the zero_scale clause's intent, which names them. No molecule is released there, so the row minus its blank is the row's coupling through M, not a survivor. The scale is the row's own magnitude, max |n_F| of the judged run at the compared times. The test is |n_F - blank| <= floor_of_scale x that scale at every compared time, with the reference 0 at every compared time. The order check is skipped, as at_the_floor does, and the table states why (the lead, 23 November 2026)

readings_confirmed: the lead checked the reader's readings against the references' own definitions (their release code and README, semantics only, no values; 23 November 2026). CO_f is route 2's exact cohort, compared as route2_exact (R1) and cohort_route2 (R2). LR_f is the released molecules still present, equal by construction to n_F_minus_blank. DL_f is a reference-side diagnostic, LR's distance from the first-order value. Route 1 against route1_blank is right: route1_sheet is the label row minus its t = 0 value, which leaves the trace's dynamics in. R1L against p = 0.75's case, the cohort at its sample times only, and the survivors through n_F_minus_blank are right too
procedure: this erratum is tagged before any judged run

the fresh runs come from a clean frozen snapshot of 3f485ee9 (scripts/gates/freeze_snapshot.py --scope full --require-clean), through engine_run.py at the test instance: R1's twelve (--worlds release) and R2's two (--worlds 'R2 returned' 'R2 held'), each at 2, 1 and 0.5 s into a fresh folder
fr38_compare table builds the table from those runs alone; its sha256 is recorded before any reference value is read
the retry, once, runs the runs the table finds inconclusive at 1, 0.5 and 0.25 s with their support runs, and its table is built and hashed the same way before any comparison
fr38_compare judge gives the verdicts, from a clean frozen snapshot of this erratum's tag
checked_before_the_tag: a synthetic end-to-end check, its engine records and its interface invented (closed forms with a step error at each declared order, under the interface's keys), with no engine run and no reference value: a consistent set passes at the declared orders; a model error, a zero-scale reference of 1e-300, a survivors' and a route-2 gap each fail their run alone; an order below its window is inconclusive, the judge refuses until the retry, and the retry with its support runs is judged at 0.25 s; a retry without its support, an unmapped published readout, a case at another tau and a non-finite reference value are refused. At the zero-rate fate the survivors pass at 1e-12 of the row's magnitude, and fail at 1e-6 of it (the lead's planted case) and at a nonzero reference (/mnt/workspaces/Cells/fr38-judged-20261123/tools/synthetic_check.py)
